answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A orchard ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A vertex expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A mirror renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 7619 identities cost 277 paid peers, 348202 tokens of stake and 17846 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
